project_type: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy backend, Python 3.12, single Docker image built from backend/ only
build_system: No build step — source is run directly. Dependencies in requirements.txt, venv at backend/venv/.
test_framework: pytest 8.3, venv at backend/venv/Scripts/python.exe, tests live in backend/tests/
verification_instructions: 1. cd to backend/. 2. Run: .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests\test_recommendation_agent.py -x -q (16 tests must pass). 3. Run: .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests\ -x -q (all tests must pass).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Model artifacts saved to backend/app/ml/artifacts/outfit_transformer.pt and backend/app/ml/artifacts/reward_model_{user_id[:8]}.pt via torch.save. These are NOT committed — they are runtime artifacts written by the training functions.
environment_constraints: PyTorch 2.15.0+cpu is installed — CPU-only, no CUDA. All torch operations must work on CPU. All new torch code must be wrapped in try/except so the agent degrades gracefully if torch is unavailable. Do NOT restart any running dev server. Run tests from the backend/ directory so imports resolve correctly.
contribution_requirements: Additive-only: do NOT break any existing test. Do NOT modify any agent file other than recommendation_agent.py. Keep all existing fields in outfit_dict. Use try/except around all torch operations.
key_patterns: 1. Module-level try/except imports for optional dependencies: see how compatibility_model and vector_store are imported at the top of recommendation_agent.py. 2. Artifacts loaded with @lru_cache + Path(__file__).resolve().parent / 'artifacts' / 'filename': see compatibility_model.py. 3. State is a TypedDict (total=False); new keys are additive. 4. Tests use _FakeItem (see test_recommendation_agent.py) and monkeypatch for module-level attributes. 5. conftest.py autouse fixture sets LLM_PROVIDER=none and RANKING_ENABLED=false — new tests should not depend on env vars. 6. vector_store.fetch_embeddings(item_ids) returns dict[Any, list[float]] where keys are both str and original type; see backend/app/db/vector_store.py.
directory_structure: backend/app/ml/ — ML models (compatibility_model.py, vision_model.py, ranking_model.py, garment_types.py) + artifacts/ subdirectory. backend/app/agents/ — all agent files (recommendation_agent.py is the one to modify). backend/app/models/ — SQLAlchemy ORM models (RecommendationFeedback, Outfit, ClothingItem). backend/app/db/ — DB session + vector_store (Pinecone + local JSON fallback). backend/tests/ — pytest tests, one file per module.
